ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_HOLDING_TESTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE query_holding_tests IS
 where_clause varchar2(600) ;
 cur_item varchar2(60) := :system.cursor_item; 
begin
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 if :control_block.unit_id is not null 
 then
 where_clause := where_clause||' unit_id = '||''''||:control_block.unit_id||''''|| ' and';
 end if;
 if :control_block.tb_id is not null
 then
 where_clause := where_clause||' tb_id = '||''''||:control_block.tb_id||''''||' and';
 end if;
 if :control_block.test_id is not null
 then
 where_clause := where_clause||' test_id = '||''''||:control_block.test_id||''''||' and';
 end if;
 where_clause := where_clause||' test_chapter_id = :control_block.test_chapter_id and ' ||
 '(:all_or_pend = ''A'' OR holding_status is null)';
 set_block_property('HOLDING_TESTS',DEFAULT_WHERE,where_clause);
 go_block('HOLDING_TESTS');
 :system.message_level := 10; 
 count_query;
 :control_block.test_count := get_block_property('HOLDING_TESTS',query_hits);
 IF :control_block.test_count > 0 THEN
 execute_query(no_validate);
 clear_message; 
 ELSE 
 go_item(cur_item);
 show_error('2306');
 END IF; 
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_ANOTHER_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_another_program (p_prog_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'lname'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 If substr(:holding_tests.tb_id,8,2)='TB' then 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_mode', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'TBID');
 Else
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_mode', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'ITBID');
 End If;
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_value', TEXT_PARAMETER, :holding_tests.tb_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 call_form( lower(p_prog_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;
